title: Outback Oven Australian Lamb Bake
description: A hearty Australian dish featuring lamb, dried cranberries, and a blend of spices, perfect for a cold winter's night. This FODMAP-friendly recipe is easy to make and serves 6 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the lamb cubes with olive oil, garlic-infused oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the lamb mixture out in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, mix the dried cranberries and rosemary sprigs in a small bowl.
After the lamb has roasted for 20 minutes, add the cranberry and rosemary mixture to the baking dish and stir to combine.
Return the baking dish to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the cranberries are tender.
Remove the baking dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
